request.text: So he's dead. I knew his smoke before I knew your face. Names are for people who stay. Eat. You walk further on bread. His name was Wend. A Wayfarer once, and then ours: a captain of the heir's finders. He raised me. Not tonight. He isn't leading you where you think. I can't. I swore. Look at what he wants, not what he says.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Female, 35-40. Excellent quality. Persona: a hooded spellcaster of a grey-clad cult, raised by an old captain she still loves, torn between her oath and the stranger she watches over. Emotion: quiet, measured, mysterious, sad, a guarded tenderness. A low, soft, velvety voice, calm and deliberate, with long silences in it; she gives nothing away, and means every word.
